decisions.reason: The source also changes the Big Block winner count and sales trigger, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY capturing both changes.
The FAQ prize description must reflect the revised Small and Big Block parameters, and a complete same-message MODIFY already records that update.
Changing prize winner counts and draw frequencies does not alter the existing rule that primary and secondary sales fund the prize pools.
The source changes draw frequency but does not change the independent ticket counters, eligibility-since-prior-draw rule, or post-draw reset behavior.
The revised number and frequency of prizes do not change random ticket-weighted selection, Chainlink VRF, on-chain execution, or Basescan verification.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random recipient rule, commission, or award of Small and Big Block tickets.
The source changes prize quantities and draw frequencies but does not resolve or alter the manual-claim versus automatic-payout workflow.
Both Small and Big Block ticket counters remain applicable, so the revised prize parameters do not require adding or removing any metadata visibility attribute.
The source does not change the $5 coded-referral commission or the award of one Small Block and one Big Block ticket per successful referral.
The revised prize schedule does not change the requirement for a flat $10 royalty on secondary sales.
Changing block-prize parameters does not affect the NFT mint number's use, persistence, or display as the referral code.
The client explicitly preserves the net prize amount and does not change mint price, founder share, referral commission, fiat-fee treatment, or primary-mint prize-pool funding.
